title: watchthelight labs
description: macOS drivers and tools for a Lenovo Legion 5: RTX 5070 graphics, Intel Xe, MediaTek MT7925 Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
headline: macOS drivers for a laptop Apple never supported.
intro: I'm getting a Lenovo Legion 5 15IAX10 to run macOS every day through OpenCore. Its Arrow Lake CPU, RTX 5070 Laptop GPU, Intel Xe iGPU and MediaTek MT7925 Wi-Fi 7 card have no macOS drivers, so these repos are the drivers and tools I wrote for them. The boot logs behind each one are public too.
research_blurb: Boot logs from the Legion and from people who run these drivers, redacted and sorted by machine. It also keeps a daily record of what related projects changed.
agents_blurb: The Claude Code skills, hooks and memory server I write this code with, and how they're set up. There's an installer if you want them on your own machine.

about.description: Who builds watchthelight labs and how to reach them.
paragraphs: I'm Bash, watchthelight on GitHub and Discord. This started with one goal: use macOS as the everyday system on my Lenovo Legion 5 15IAX10.

Most of that laptop has no macOS support, so I write the missing parts. NvGfx and XeGfx drive the two GPUs, the mt7925 projects cover Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, and the Legion kexts handle power, input and audio. Several build on other people's work, and each repo credits them.
Other machines run some of these now too: an HP OMEN 16 and another Legion use the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth drivers. If you try one on your hardware, the logs you send help the next person.
